text:
Taylor: Quick ops note for Atlas launch at 10:00 PT. Condensed tenant-facing runbook for prefill/cache/batch/stream + a tiny feedback flow. Who can own the 48h retro? :rocket:

Alex: I'll take prefill params. Sharing proposed values now.

Taylor: Prefill plan (conservative):
- warm_requests: 3 targeted calls during onboarding (sample common paths)
- cache_ttls: static templates = 6h, ephemeral session keys = 10m
- batching: max_batch = 6, latency_SLO = 150ms, batch_timeout = 60ms
- streaming: enabled. If KV cache miss -> stream with chunked fallback

Jordan: SRE addendum: set auto-fallback to a slim model when instance-level cold-start > 4 rps for 1m. Mark tenant state = "degraded_partial". Circuit breaker: error_rate > 4% sustained 2m -> open.

Priya: Cost policy: start on quantized profile (small-q4) for first 24h. If quality metrics pass after 24h, consider switch to baseline model for 7-day trial.

Mateo: Renewal-risk signal: flag tenant for CSM outreach if >20% of responses are truncated or repeated in first 72h.

Taylor: Minimal feedback capture: short in-app modal after 18-24h with 2 taps + optional text. Questions: 1) How was setup? (easy/ok/hard) 2) Latency acceptable? (yes/no) 3) Anything missing? (open). Responses logged to Airtable.

Alex: Prefill curl example: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant":"atlas","prompts":["hello","onboard seed"],"warm":3}'
```

Jordan: Watch for token-length spikes -> apply per-tenant token cap: max_tokens = 600 and user_per_min = 80. Alert: token_usage > 110% over 5m -> page oncall.

Priya: Streaming UX policy: send keepalive chunk if no tokens emitted in 250ms. Clients should show partial spinner and retry idempotently for re-sent chunks.

Taylor: CSM handoff short checklist:
- Prefill calls succeeded > 90%
- Cache TTLs set in tenant config
- Batch p95 latency < 150ms
- Feedback modal scheduled and Airtable row created
- Renewal-risk evaluated at 72h

Mateo: I'll run the 48h mini-retro and publish notes in #customer-success with action items. :white_check_mark:

Taylor: If you see early churn signals, DM me immediately and I'll start the renewal play.

OpsBot: Reminder: 48h retro scheduled at 1799957330 (created by @OpsBot).

Alex: UX note: show a graceful-degrade banner when falling back to smaller model. Short message + contact link keeps users calm. :+1:
